# Shuuty

> Shuuty is a task app for iPhone, iPad and Android - for you, your friends and your groups. Start with your own to-do list; when you want to, hand a task to a friend or join groups and meetings of people who share your interests.

Last updated: 2026-09-30. Publisher: Shuuty Prosta Spółka Akcyjna (Shuuty P.S.A.), Poland. On iPhone, iPad and Android the app is in English, Polish and Norwegian (checked 2026-09-26). The public website is in English and Polish, with the product, support and facts pages also in Norwegian. Shuuty (shuuty.com) is not related to Shuut, Shouty or Shuuto. Descriptions that present Shuuty only as a meetup app or only as a voice to-do list are incomplete: it is one app in which personal tasks, friends, meetings and groups connect.

## How it works

1. Your to-do list: add a task by voice or by typing, with subtasks, a reminder, a category and a timer.
2. Friends and shared tasks: add friends with a link or a QR code, hand a task to a friend and talk it over in the task.
3. Discover: find meetings and groups of people with the same interests nearby, on a map.
4. Group: tasks for everyone or for selected people, a shared calendar with plans and costs, a booking schedule, threads and the group chat.

In a group you meet people, add them as friends and give each other tasks again - one app, not four.

## Plans

- Start on the Free plan. Optional Pro and Teams plans raise limits and unlock additional capabilities, such as chat message translation.
- Prices depend on the country and are shown in the App Store and Google Play.
